confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-044 business-calendar date parsed as instant
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Recall/publication date-only fixture strings flow to new Date and browser-local formatDate. YYYY-MM-DD becomes UTC midnight, so west-of-UTC browsers can display previous calendar day. ISO-title assertions do not prove visible business-date preservation.
confirmedIssues.repro: report_received_at=2026-07-01 with America/Los_Angeles browser timezone represents June30 locally. Source/ECMAScript semantics only; no fresh execution.
confirmedIssues.fix: Existing locale-aware day-key formatter for publication business dates; separate true instant formatting. No invented workspace bounds.
confirmedIssues.reproStatus: SOURCE_CONFIRMED; specified synthetic/manual repro NOTRUN; no real action

confirmedIssues.mechanism: Service callers omit in/showTz and take PureDateTime without settings/timezone inputs. Actual timestamps are browser locale/timezone formatted; full timestamp options do not carry saved12/24-hour choice. Shared formatter presence is not effective preference preservation.
confirmedIssues.repro: Browser en-US/UTC versus saved alternate locale/timezone: generated/checked/fetched/observed timestamps receive no preference options. Distinct from calendar-day shift/raw warranty string.
confirmedIssues.fix: Reuse preference-aware instant boundaries and coordinate clock capability at existing owner; never convert business day keys to instants or create another formatter.
confirmedIssues.reproStatus: SOURCE_CONFIRMED; specified synthetic/manual repro NOTRUN; no real action
